android_update_system_enabled.description: Master switch for the Android app update system.

android_optional_update_enabled.description: Shows optional Google Play updates on the home screen.

android_min_supported_build.description: Minimum supported Android versionCode. Keep at zero until a replacement build is fully available.

android_optional_update_title_ar.description: Arabic title for optional update prompts.

defaultValue.value: حدّث التطبيق للحصول على أحدث التحسينات والإصلاحات.

android_optional_update_message_ar.description: Arabic message for optional update prompts.

android_required_update_title_ar.description: Arabic title for the unsupported-version gate.

defaultValue.value: هذا الإصدار لم يعد مدعومًا. حدّث التطبيق لمتابعة استخدامه.

android_required_update_message_ar.description: Arabic message for the unsupported-version gate.

android_reader_interstitial_enabled.description: Master switch for interstitial ads between reader chapters.

android_reader_interstitial_min_chapters.description: Minimum forward chapter transitions before a reader interstitial.

android_reader_interstitial_max_chapters.description: Maximum forward chapter transitions before a reader interstitial.

android_in_app_review_enabled.description: Master switch for automatic Google Play in-app review prompts.

android_in_app_review_min_days.description: Minimum installation age in days before an automatic review attempt.

android_in_app_review_min_completed_chap.description: Minimum locally completed chapters before an automatic review attempt.

android_in_app_review_min_sessions.description: Minimum qualifying reader sessions before an automatic review attempt.

android_in_app_review_cooldown_days.description: Cooldown between automatic review attempts or after opening the store manually.

android_in_app_review_max_attempts.description: Maximum automatic review requests during one installation.
